scientific_integrity: The point-or-circle theorem and cycle winding counts are credited to prior literature. The new claim is the integral natural automorphism module and rational dihedral-color quotient Betti formula, proved by deck-group orientation and transfer, corroborated by finite computations.
scientific_limitations: Only connected graphs with an edge and cycle targets k>=3 excluding k=4; quotient formula only for cycle sources and target dihedral actions, rational coefficient field. Independent validation not performed; unknown equivalent prior formulations remain possible.
title: Dihedral orientation of graph Hom circles and cycle-coloring quotients
